resources.string: Privacy and cleanup controls for Facebook Messenger, powered by the Modern Xposed API.
Privacy and cleanup controls for Messenger. Everything is opt-in.
Enable this module for Messenger in LSPosed or Vector, then reopen this app.
Changes apply after Messenger restarts. The hook reads your switches when Messenger loads and does not hot-swap while it is running.
The descriptor scan runs once per Messenger version and is cached inside Messenger\'s data directory.
